question: How should one progress through the stages of bliss toward the peaceful ground?
premises: One intent on complete rest should abandon the former stage and ascend to the higher stage.
The ground consisting of innate bliss follows the peaceful state.
Progression through stages is oriented toward that innate-bliss ground.
inference: Therefore the practitioner should sequentially transcend lower stages to reach the innate-bliss ground that leads to peace.
plain_english: Intent on complete rest, one should abandon the former stage and move to the higher one, because the ground of innate bliss follows upon the peaceful state.
